title: The raw normal reference earns an actual slow episode without a mixing gap
statement: For capped phases i,j∈{0,1,2,3},include EVERY physical x=rho+k w+y_i+z_j>=0,w=(0,-2,-2,0,2,2),including signed residual boundary coordinates. All normal transitions preserve Z. The raw reference mu(i,j,k)=2^k/[alpha_i beta_j product_l x_l!] satisfies mu Q=0 on the full finite normal cell. It is never substituted for the entrance or surviving trajectory. With ALL unexpected hazards h,G=(-Q+diag h)^-1 is the actual occupation kernel. Raw renewal gives row sums<=C(N+15);its actual adjoint has row sums<=C*(N+15)^4 and G(i,j)<=C*(N+15)^4 mu(j)/mu(i). Exact factorial ratios give an exponential cold-reference barrier and hence paid actual cold occupation for inputs in an acquired reference band,initially bounded pair differences. Actual crossing counts compare every harmful phase3 and neutral phase1 exit with repaying phase2 exits;P_g>=p0>0,E Delta Z<=-p0/2,E(Delta Z)^2<=9. Thus at the SAME first unexpected source E[sigma+D Z_out^2]<=D Z_in^2 with E sigma=O(N),all outputs including anchor4 received. Bounded-buffer neighboring-cell deficit changes are proved O(log(N+15)),not assumed. The star extension separately earns uniformity in a small-relative-difference cone;arbitrary cold entrances/large differences are not inferred from this band theorem.

requires: Two ordered degree-seven blocks 0→AB→2A+B+C→3A+2B+2C→0 and 0→DE→2D+E+F→3D+2E+2F→0,all block rates fixed positive;conservative A+D+2B+2C↔A+D+2E+2F at rates2,1. Ordinary falling-factorial propensities without factorial divisors.

Each operation uses its proved input region and actual stopping/output class at U=D Z^2,Z=15+|x|-m(A)-m(D),m=(0,2,4,7,7,...). Small relative pair-difference cone is essential for the unbounded launch/terminal ports.
